{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check for -1 in customer_age
print(f"Number of rows with customer_age == -1: {data[data['customer_age'] == -1].shape[0]}")

# Check revenue format
print(f"Unique revenue values (first 10): {data['revenue'].unique()[:10]}")

# Check for QA orders
qa_orders = data[data['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded = data[data['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded)}")

# Check the combination of new + paid_search
new_paid_search = data[(data['customer_segment'] == 'new') & (data['channel'] == 'paid_search')]
print(f"Rows with customer_segment == 'new' and channel == 'paid_search': {len(new_paid_search)}")

# Check conversion rate in this group
converted_count = new_paid_search['converted'].sum()
total_count = len(new_paid_search)
print(f"Converted count in new + paid_search: {converted_count}")
print(f"Total count in new + paid_search: {total_count}")

# Print the raw data for new + paid_search
print("\nFirst few rows of new + paid_search:")
print(new_paid_search.head())"}
